text:
CHI and BOS meet tonight with both teams coming off a 4-1 loss two days ago, Chicago at DET and Boston at STL. The Blackhawks are 1-4-0 in their last five and playing without Bowen Byram, with Wyatt Kaiser and Ian Cole picking up extra minutes. The Bruins are 2-2-1 over the same stretch, and their +19 goal difference runs well ahead of their chances. Finishing and goaltending are doing that work, while CHI's results sit behind its play.

At five on five, Boston has taken 52% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) against Chicago's 41%. Our model has BOS at 3.35 goals tonight and CHI at 2.87. Boston takes 4.8 penalties a game, which keeps feeding power plays. In net, projected starters Arvid Soderblom (CHI) is at -4.0 goals saved above expected this season, while Michael DiPietro (BOS) is at +3.9.

Connor Bedard is our top Chicago scoring pick at 35% to score and 71% for a point, on a five-game point streak. Scott Powers of The Athletic posted that Bedard called Thursday probably the team's best game of the season. David Pastrnak is 35% to score and 80% for a point. Under-the-radar, we like Casey Mittelstadt (BOS), a third-liner with dangerous shots lately, at 21% to score, and Roman Kantserov (CHI), 54% for a point.
